translations.web: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.
translations.bsb: Yet another man dies in the bitterness of his soul, having never tasted prosperity.
translations.kjv: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul, and never eateth with pleasure.
translations.asv: And another dieth in bitterness of soul, And never tasteth of good.
